# U.S. Pharmacist

> The leading clinical pharmacy journal providing peer-reviewed articles, clinical guidance, and professional resources for pharmacists across all practice settings.

U.S. Pharmacist is a comprehensive resource for pharmacy professionals covering clinical practice, medication management, regulatory compliance, and emerging healthcare technologies. The site serves as a trusted source for continuing education, drug information, and practice guidelines for pharmacists in community, hospital, and specialty pharmacy settings.

## Key Topics

- Medication Management
- Pharmacist Education
- Drug Approvals
- Biosimilars
- Pharmacy Practice
- Hospital Pharmacy
- Compliance & Regulations
- Telepharmacy
- Personalized Medicine
- Generic Drugs
- Patient Care
- Disease Management
- FDA
- Medication Adherence
- AI & Technology

## Clinical Practice & Medication Management

- [Medication Management](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/medication-management): Pharmacotherapy and disease management with pharmacogenomics focus
- [Geriatrics](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/geriatrics): Medication management and disease treatment for elderly patients
- [Allergy](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/allergy): Allergy management, anaphylaxis, and epinephrine autoinjector education
- [Asthma](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/asthma): Asthma management guidelines and biological agent therapy information

## Regulatory Compliance & Standards

- [Compliance](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/compliance): USP standards 797, 800, 795 and pharmacy compliance requirements
- [Law](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/law): Pharmacy law, DEA compliance, HIPAA, and pharmacist scope of practice
- [Compounding](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/compounding): Pharmaceutical compounding formulations and recipes for pharmacists

## Drug Information & Approvals

- [Drug Approvals](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/drug-approvals): FDA drug approvals, NME reviews, and new drug launch information
- [Biosimilars](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/biosimilars): Coverage of biosimilar drugs including Adalimumab and Trastuzumab approvals
- [Affordable Medicines](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/affordable-medicines): Articles on generic drugs, biosimilars, and medication access affordability
- [OTC](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/otc): Over-the-counter medications, supplements, and pain management resources

## Specialized Pharmacy Practice

- [In-Pharmacy Vaccines](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/in-pharmacy-vaccines): Vaccine recommendations including RSV, COVID-19, and influenza vaccines
- [Specialty Pharmacy](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/specialty-pharmacy): Specialty pharmacy, biologic drugs, and rare disease management
- [Hospital/Health System](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/hospital-health-system): Hospital pharmacy practice and clinical education for health systems
- [Pharmacy Technician](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/pharmacy-technician): Pharmacy technician education and telepharmacy practice information

## Professional Development & Resources

- [Pharmacist Resources](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/pharmacist-resources): Professional development and clinical practice resources for pharmacists
- [Technology](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/technology): Pharmacy technology, AI, telepharmacy, and personalized medicine
- [News and Trends](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/news-and-trends): Pharmaceutical news, drug safety updates, and clinical research trends

## Optional

- [Pharmacy Week](https://www.uspharmacist.com/topic/pharmacy-week): Pharmacy Week coverage and pharmacist recognition articles
- [U.S. Pharmacist Home](https://www.uspharmacist.com): Leading clinical pharmacy journal providing peer-reviewed articles for pharmacists
